CONSTRUCTIONCONSTRUCCIÓN

Hernán Patrón Ancona

General Director
Kimikolor
Company Profile

Founded in Yucatán in 2006, Kimikolor develops, manufactures and markets architectural finishing products: decorative coatings, Chukum-inspired finishes, architectural mortars, stamped, polished and oxidized concrete, waterproofing systems, sealers, pigments and additives, together with the equipment, tools and technical advice needed for proper application.

Through the Kimikolor Institute it trains applicators, contractors and construction professionals. The company holds the Socially Responsible Company (ESR) distinction and the Hecho en México and Hecho en Yucatán distinctions, and has a commercial presence in Mexico, the Caribbean, Central and South America, the United States and Italy.

Professional Background

Hernán Patrón Ancona is General Director of Kimikolor, the Yucatán manufacturer of architectural finishes founded in 2006. Under his leadership, the company has built a solid national and international presence — with operations in the United States, the Caribbean, Central and South America, and Italy — and stands out for combining technical innovation with textures and tones inspired by Mexican aesthetics.

Objectives for the Mission
“Kimikolor seeks distributors and strategic partners in Florida — distributors, contractors, architects, designers and developers — for its Yucatán-inspired architectural finishes, backed by technical support and professional training through the Kimikolor Institute.”

Hernán Patrón Ancona

Director General
Kimikolor
Perfil de la Empresa

Fundada en Yucatán en 2006, Kimikolor desarrolla, fabrica y comercializa productos de acabados arquitectónicos: recubrimientos decorativos, acabados inspirados en el chukum, morteros arquitectónicos, concreto estampado, pulido y oxidado, impermeabilizantes, selladores, pigmentos y aditivos, junto con el equipo, las herramientas y la asesoría técnica necesarios para su correcta aplicación.

A través del Instituto Kimikolor capacita a aplicadores, contratistas y profesionales de la construcción. Cuenta con el distintivo de Empresa Socialmente Responsable (ESR) y con los distintivos Hecho en México y Hecho en Yucatán, y tiene presencia comercial en México, el Caribe, Centro y Sudamérica, Estados Unidos e Italia.

Trayectoria Profesional

Hernán Patrón Ancona es Director General de Kimikolor, fabricante yucateco de acabados arquitectónicos fundado en 2006. Bajo su liderazgo, la empresa ha construido una sólida presencia nacional e internacional —con operaciones en Estados Unidos, el Caribe, Centro y Sudamérica, e Italia— y se distingue por combinar la innovación técnica con texturas y tonos inspirados en la estética mexicana.

Ricardo Arturo González Mier y Terán

Commercial Director
Steelex
Steel Structures · Tim del Mayab, S.A. de C.V.
Company Profile

Steelex is the leading fabricator of structural steel and steel products in southeast Mexico, with more than 30 years of experience and a production capacity of over 3,000 tons per month. AISC, AWS and ISO 9000 certified, it can fabricate projects from a warehouse to a skyscraper, and its location is well suited for transport to the United States.

Its facility of nearly 1.6 million square feet operates CNC machinery, robotics, semi-automated arc welding, production-management systems (STRUMIS, STEELPROJECT) and TEKLA BIM modeling to minimize rework. Steelex has delivered hospitals, hotels, mixed-use and office towers, and production facilities ranging from agro-industry to boat assembly lines.

Professional Background

Ricardo Arturo González Mier y Terán is Commercial Director of Steelex, the leading structural-steel fabricator in southeast Mexico. Drawing on solid experience in the industrial and construction sectors, he leads the company's commercial strategy, new-business development and engagement with large-scale regional and national projects.

Ricardo Arturo González Mier y Terán

Director Comercial
Steelex
Estructuras Metálicas · Tim del Mayab, S.A. de C.V.
Perfil de la Empresa

Steelex es el fabricante líder de estructura metálica y productos de acero del sureste de México, con más de 30 años de experiencia y capacidad de producción de más de 3,000 toneladas mensuales. Con certificaciones AISC, AWS e ISO 9000, fabrica desde una bodega hasta un rascacielos, y su ubicación es privilegiada para el transporte a Estados Unidos.

Su planta de casi 1.6 millones de pies cuadrados opera maquinaria CNC, robótica, soldadura de arco semiautomatizada, sistemas de gestión de producción (STRUMIS, STEELPROJECT) y modelado BIM con TEKLA para minimizar retrabajos. Ha participado en hospitales, hoteles, edificios de usos mixtos y oficinas, y plantas productivas desde agroindustria hasta líneas de ensamble de embarcaciones.

Trayectoria Profesional

Ricardo Arturo González Mier y Terán es Director Comercial de Steelex, la principal fabricante de estructuras de acero del sureste de México. Con sólida experiencia en los sectores industrial y de la construcción, encabeza la estrategia comercial de la empresa, el desarrollo de nuevos negocios y la vinculación con proyectos regionales y nacionales de gran escala.

Esteban Walker Juanes

Commercial Manager
Grupo Metal Tec
Construcciones Verticales de Acero, S.A. de C.V.
Company Profile

Grupo Metal Tec (Construcciones Verticales de Acero) has more than 40 years of experience fabricating and erecting structural steel. From its plant in Mérida, Yucatán, it serves projects across Mexico and has begun exporting to the United States, offering the complete service — shop fabrication and field erection with its own equipment — so the client has a single party responsible from start to finish.

With a capacity of about 2,000 tons a month, AISC and AWS certifications and STRUMIS-controlled production for full traceability, it has built industrial buildings of more than 100,000 m² of roofed area for clients such as Walmart and Amazon, and dozens of shopping centers in Quintana Roo delivered on fixed opening dates.

Professional Background

Esteban Walker Juanes is the third generation of Grupo Metal Tec, a family company with more than 40 years fabricating and erecting structural steel, AISC and AWS certified. After 10 years with the company, he now drives its commercial growth in Mexico and the United States.

CONSTRUCTIONCONSTRUCCIÓN

Carlos Alberto Quintal Lugo

Partner and Commercial & Financial Head
STRNG
Concrete Studio
Company Profile

STRNG is a Yucatán design-and-fabrication studio dedicated to exploring the potential of concrete. Its catalog — architectural screens, wall cladding, flooring, bollards and furniture — is handcrafted by architects, designers and artists to complement contemporary architecture, and a custom design-and-manufacturing service lets architects bring their own pieces to life. Every project is made to order, with the client choosing product and concrete tone.

STRNG completes more than 500 projects a year across Mexico, mainly for hospitality and residential clients. Its facilities produce over 80,000 façade and cladding pieces a year (approx. 45,000+ sq ft), with a second Yucatán plant planned for 2027. Since 2025 it has exported to the United States (Alabama, Florida, Georgia and Texas) and the Bahamas.

Professional Background

Carlos Quintal is an architect with an MBA and more than 14 years of experience in the manufacture of architectural concrete products, driven by a passion for creative and industrial design. He is a partner at STRNG, where he leads the commercial area, and a professor at the School of Architecture and Design of Universidad Marista de Mérida.

Carlos Alberto Quintal Lugo

Socio y Responsable Comercial y Financiero
STRNG
Taller de Concreto
Perfil de la Empresa

STRNG es un taller yucateco dedicado a explorar el potencial del concreto. Su catálogo —celosías, recubrimientos para muro, pisos, bolardos y mobiliario— es creado a mano por arquitectos, diseñadores y artistas para convivir con la arquitectura contemporánea, y su servicio de asesoría y manufactura personalizada permite a los arquitectos llevar sus propias piezas a la realidad. Cada proyecto se fabrica bajo pedido; el cliente elige producto y tonalidad.

STRNG realiza más de 500 proyectos anuales en todo México, principalmente para los sectores hospitality y residencial. Sus instalaciones producen más de 80,000 piezas de fachada y recubrimiento al año (aprox. +45,000 sqft) y en 2027 sumará una segunda planta en Yucatán. Desde 2025 exporta a Estados Unidos (Alabama, Florida, Georgia y Texas) y Bahamas.

Trayectoria Profesional

Arquitecto con MBA, apasionado del diseño creativo e industrial, con más de 14 años de experiencia en la manufactura de productos arquitectónicos de concreto. Es socio de STRNG, donde dirige el área comercial, y profesor en la Escuela de Arquitectura y Diseño de la Universidad Marista de Mérida.

Juan Pablo Ávila Cetina

Commercial Manager, Industry Division
Grupo Constructor PROSER
Industry Division
Company Profile

PROSER is a Yucatán construction group with more than 35 years of experience and over 200 projects across Mexico. Its Industry Division integrates four specialized units — Konkret (ready-mix concrete), Agregados (crushed aggregates), Vidrio Bisel (tempered glass) and MEGA Carpintería (high-end millwork) — that secure supply, quality and control at every stage of construction.

The division serves residential and commercial building, infrastructure and civil works, hospitality and restaurants, healthcare and industry, with a strong focus on quality, material traceability and long-term client relationships. MEGA works with clients from budgeting through installation, using automated high-end machinery and premium wood. Its capacity includes about 160,000 m³ of aggregates and 700 tons of tempered glass, plus made-to-order millwork.

Professional Background

Juan Pablo Ávila Cetina is Commercial Manager of PROSER's Industry Division, with a solid track record in commercial management and business development in the infrastructure and construction sector. He leads the division's market-positioning strategies, key-account development and expansion into strategic projects, and on this mission is focused on exporting high-end architectural millwork and architectural limestone.

Juan Pablo Ávila Cetina

Gerente Comercial de Industria
Grupo Constructor PROSER
División Industria
Perfil de la Empresa

PROSER es un grupo constructor yucateco con más de 35 años de experiencia y más de 200 obras en el país. Su División Industria integra cuatro unidades especializadas —Konkret (concreto premezclado), Agregados (trituración), Vidrio Bisel (vidrio templado) y MEGA Carpintería (carpintería de alta gama)— que garantizan suministro, calidad y control en cada etapa constructiva.

La división atiende edificación residencial y comercial, infraestructura y obra civil, hotelería y restaurantes, salud e industria, con enfoque en calidad, trazabilidad de materiales y relaciones de largo plazo. MEGA acompaña al cliente desde el presupuesto hasta la instalación, con maquinaria automatizada de alta gama y las mejores maderas. Su capacidad incluye cerca de 160,000 m³ de agregados y 700 toneladas de vidrio templado, además de carpintería sobre pedido.

Trayectoria Profesional

Juan Pablo Ávila Cetina es Gerente Comercial de la División Industria de PROSER, con una sólida trayectoria en gestión comercial y desarrollo de negocios en el sector de infraestructura y construcción. Encabeza las estrategias de posicionamiento de mercado de la división, el desarrollo de cuentas clave y la expansión hacia proyectos estratégicos; en esta misión se enfoca en la exportación de carpintería arquitectónica de alta gama y piedra caliza arquitectónica.

MANUFACTURINGMANUFACTURA

Luis Jorge Barbosa Polanco

Director
Gabar Eléctrica
Company Profile

Gabar Eléctrica is an industrial and commercial electrical-installation company with 23 years of experience in low-, medium- and high-voltage projects and a national presence. As part of its vertical integration it operates a switchboard-integration plant that builds ABB- and Siemens-brand power and control panels with custom engineering for each project, and it distributes ABB, Siemens, Rittal and Viakon.

It specializes in the cement and food-and-beverage industries, is developing switchboard engineering for data centers, holds ISO 9001, ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 certifications and the ESR distinction, and counts Grupo KUO, LafargeHolcim, Sigma, Bepensa and ICA among its main clients.

Professional Background

Luis Jorge Barbosa Polanco is an electrical engineer with 45 years of professional experience and the founder and Director of Gabar Eléctrica, a company dedicated to low-, medium- and high-voltage industrial electrical installations and the integration of power and control switchboards, now developing switchboard engineering for data centers.

Company Profile

Founded in 1985, Industrias Carrera designs, fabricates and fully outfits commercial kitchens for hotels, restaurants, bakeries, cafés and other foodservice businesses. Its own stainless-steel factory builds custom furniture and fixtures — work tables, hoods, sinks and structures — and an in-house team of architects and specialists designs functional, efficient projects. David Ordóñez Guerrero

Commercial Manager & Partner
Industrias Ordóñez
Company Profile

Industrias Ordóñez designs and manufactures furniture at its plant in Umán, Yucatán, continuing a family business history that began in 1926. It operates two complementary brands: Ofindustrias, for office and workspace furniture, and ARMETI, created in 2005 for hospitality, residential and commercial projects. ARMETI produces volume and made-to-order furniture — kitchens, cabinets, closets, guest-room and commercial furniture — from the client's drawings or co-developed designs, and can integrate design, manufacturing, delivery and installation.

Expanded and modernized in 2022 with CNC machinery, the Umán plant produces about 3,000 pieces of furniture a month, with capacity close to 1,000 units a month for a single model. New buyers can start gradually: drawing review, prototype approval and a pilot lot before series production.

Professional Background

David Ordóñez Guerrero is Commercial Manager and a partner of Industrias Ordóñez, a manufacturer of cabinets and custom furniture for hotels and commercial spaces in Yucatán, Mexico. He leads the company's commercial development for contract and FF&E furniture — designed, manufactured and installed for hospitality, retail and residential projects — and, on this mission, is seeking partnerships with buyers and project integrators.

Mario S. Polanco Ayala

Deputy Commercial Director
Industria Salinera de Yucatán
Grupo Industrial Roche
Company Profile

Industria Salinera de Yucatán produces and markets industrial and food-grade sea salt, obtained naturally through the solar and wind evaporation of seawater, with a production capacity of 700,000 tons per year. It offers the full range of grain sizes required by industry and the consumer market.

Its SAL SOL brand (table and coarse salt) is the No. 1 sea salt brand in Mexico, present in every national supermarket chain and with the country's leading wholesalers. Its ROCHE brand is an industry leader in Mexico for its quality and range of grain sizes. The company already serves Texas and neighboring states.

Professional Background

An industrial engineer, Mario Polanco has served as Deputy Commercial Director of Industria Salinera de Yucatán for 20 years, with commercial experience across supermarket, wholesale, hard-discount and industrial channels, as well as in sea-salt production and marketing. His team has positioned SAL SOL as Mexico's No. 1 sea salt brand and ROCHE as an industry leader. He is a Board Member of the Mexican Salt Industry Association (Asociación Mexicana de la Industria Salinera) and Vice President of CANACINTRA Yucatán.

Industria Salinera de Yucatán produce y comercializa sal de mar industrial y de consumo humano, obtenida por métodos naturales de evaporación del agua de mar por sol y viento, con una capacidad de 700,000 toneladas al año. BUSINESS ORG.ORGANISMO EMPRESARIAL

Alejandro Guerrero Lozano

Past President
INDEX Yucatán
Export Manufacturing Industry Association
Organization Profile

For more than 40 years, INDEX Yucatán has represented the export-oriented manufacturing companies operating in Yucatán, serving as their institutional voice before federal, state and local authorities. Its members span textiles and apparel, furniture, electronics, aerospace, automotive, jewelry, medical devices and marine manufacturing, including luxury yachts and boats. Together they generate billions of U.S. dollars in exports, approximately 85% of them destined for the United States.

INDEX Yucatán also acts as a private-sector soft-landing partner for companies evaluating Yucatán as an investment destination, supporting their due diligence and providing guidance on the regulatory, customs, fiscal and operational environment required to establish manufacturing operations in Mexico.

Professional Background

Alejandro Guerrero is a Public Accountant from the University of Yucatán with an MBA in International Business and Senior Management from Universidad Anáhuac, and executive training at Anáhuac and MIT, the University of Wisconsin, the American Management Association and Tec de Monterrey. Since 1995 he has served at Monty Mexico — the Mexican subsidiaries of Hong Kong–based Monty Group, which produce garments for the U.S., Canadian, European and Asian markets — where he is Managing Director. He chaired the Board of INDEX Yucatán in 2010–2012 and 2022–2025, is a former President of Yucatán's Business Coordinating Council (CCE), has been a National Counselor of INDEX Mexico since 2008, and sits on the boards of CANAIVE and CANACINTRA. In 2010 the U.S. Embassy named him Young NAFTA Leader for Mexico.

Esteban Roche Rivero

President
Consejo Coordinador Empresarial de Yucatán (CCE)
Organization Profile

The Consejo Coordinador Empresarial de Yucatán (CCE) is the highest representative body of the state's private sector. It brings together and coordinates the 19 business chambers and organizations that comprise it.

Its core role is to act as the private sector's unified interlocutor before all three levels of government and civil society, promoting public policies that foster investment, competitiveness and sustainable economic growth in the region.

Professional Background

Esteban Roche Rivero is President of the Consejo Coordinador Empresarial de Yucatán (CCE), where he serves as the leading voice and spokesperson of the 19 business chambers and organizations that make up the Council. He holds a degree in Business Administration from Universidad del Mayab and has more than 20 years of experience in the industrial and commercial sectors. He has also presided over the Yucatán chapter of the National Chamber of the Manufacturing Industry (CANACINTRA), promoting industrial competitiveness, innovation and closer ties among industry, academia and government. Since 2003 he has been part of Grupo Industrial Roche — a sea-salt producer through Industria Salinera de Yucatán — where he advanced from Sales Manager to Deputy Commercial Director and, since 2018, Commercial Director.

Perfil del Organismo

El Consejo Coordinador Empresarial de Yucatán (CCE) es el máximo organismo de representación del sector privado del estado. Agrupa y coordina a las 19 cámaras y organizaciones empresariales que lo integran.

Su función central es actuar como interlocutor unificado del sector privado ante los tres órdenes de gobierno y la sociedad civil, impulsando políticas públicas que favorezcan la inversión, la competitividad y el crecimiento económico sostenible de la región.

Trayectoria Profesional

Esteban Roche Rivero es Presidente del Consejo Coordinador Empresarial de Yucatán (CCE), donde funge como principal voz y vocero de las 19 cámaras y organizaciones empresariales que integran el Consejo. Es Licenciado en Administración de Empresas por la Universidad del Mayab y cuenta con más de 20 años de experiencia en los sectores industrial y comercial. También presidió la delegación Yucatán de la Cámara Nacional de la Industria de Transformación (CANACINTRA), donde impulsó la competitividad industrial, la innovación y la vinculación entre industria, academia y gobierno. Desde 2003 forma parte de Grupo Industrial Roche —productor de sal marina a través de Industria Salinera de Yucatán—, donde pasó de Gerente de Ventas a Subdirector Comercial y, desde 2018, a Director Comercial.

José Antonio Martínez Banda

Customs Broker
Red Aduanera Peninsular
Company Profile

Corporativo Red Aduanera Peninsular is a foreign-trade and logistics group from southeast Mexico with more than 30 years of experience in customs brokerage. It provides foreign-trade consulting and customs clearance for imports and exports — including perishables and produce — with operations to the United States (Atlanta, Panama City, Miami and Orlando), Europe and the Dominican Republic.

Its customs services are complemented by ground, air and ocean transportation and strategically located logistics and warehousing centers, giving clients end-to-end coverage with continuity, security and efficiency. The group holds ISO 9001, Authorized Logistics Operator (OLA), IATA and Socially Responsible Company (ESR) credentials.

Professional Background

José Antonio Martínez Banda is a customs broker with more than 30 years of experience and the founder of Red Aduanera Peninsular, where he leads customs clearance, import, export and international logistics services across the Yucatán Peninsula. His leadership extends to business and economic-development organizations, including COPARMEX, the Confederation of Customs Broker Associations of Mexico (CAAAREM) and several business organizations in the Yucatán Peninsula.

Víctor Pérez Castro

General Director
Contenedores Consolidados de Yucatán (CCY)
Yucatán Fish
Company Profile

Contenedores Consolidados de Yucatán (CCY) lets companies source directly from Mexico with a single logistics partner. Clients can ship as little as a single pallet and access comprehensive import-export and cross-border solutions over infrastructure that connects Mexico directly to the United States; CCY also helps buyers source products through reliable suppliers.

Its services include international freight forwarding (cargo consolidation, ocean and overland freight, door-to-door coordination), export management and documentation, U.S. customs clearance and pallet-level distribution in the United States, all-risk cargo insurance, trade financing and factoring for exporters, and business-development consulting with optional buyer matching.

Yucatán Fish, based in Puerto Progreso, processes, freezes and markets fresh fish and seafood — mainly grouper, snapper, octopus and blue runner — with FDA and HACCP certifications, supplying the domestic market and distributors in the United States (including Florida, New York and California) and Canada.

Professional Background

Víctor Pérez Castro is a fisheries entrepreneur with more than 20 years of experience in seafood exports. He currently leads Contenedores Consolidados de Yucatán, which provides full-service freight logistics from Mexico to the United States, handling shipments starting from a single pallet. On this mission he also represents Yucatán Fish, the Puerto Progreso seafood processor and exporter.

It offers regular ocean freight service between Progreso, Yucatán, and U.S. Gulf Coast ports, including Panama City, Florida, and Houston, Texas.

Beyond ocean transportation, it provides integrated logistics solutions: containerized cargo, breakbulk and project cargo, heavy equipment transportation, warehousing, cargo consolidation, inland trucking and customs coordination. Its competitive advantages are extensive experience, strategic connectivity, operational flexibility and personalized customer service.

Professional Background

Armando Bolio Sansores is Administrative Manager of Línea Peninsular MX, with more than 24 years of experience in the maritime, port and logistics industries. He has built a comprehensive understanding of maritime transportation, international trade and integrated logistics, contributing to the company's growth and its long-standing role connecting the Yucatán Peninsula with the United States. His approach combines strategic financial management, operational insight and a strong commitment to collaboration and long-term business relationships.

MARITIMEMARÍTIMO

Daniela Silva Sanabria

Chief Commercial Officer, Mexico
APM Terminals
Port of Progreso
Company Profile

APM Terminals Yucatán operates the specialized container terminal at the Port of Progreso, a strategic asset for the Yucatán Peninsula's foreign trade and its connection to international markets.

The terminal provides services for the safe and efficient handling of containerized cargo, including import and export operations, refrigerated cargo, storage and value-added logistics solutions through its bonded facility.

With more than two decades of experience in Progreso and the backing of APM Terminals' global network, it combines local market knowledge with international standards of operation, safety and service. It holds certifications and runs systems designed to strengthen supply chain security, and is currently advancing a modernization program that includes new infrastructure, technology and electric equipment.

Its value proposition is built on supporting shipping lines, exporters, importers and logistics operators with solutions that streamline the movement of goods, strengthen regional competitiveness and help capture new trade opportunities between Yucatán and markets such as the United States.

Professional Background

Daniela Silva is Chief Commercial Officer of APM Terminals Mexico, a role she took on as part of the evolution of the company's commercial model in the country. She brings regional experience in the maritime and logistics industry and has held leadership positions across port terminals, shipping lines and international logistics operators. She is known for her strategic vision, results orientation and focus on building relationships with key customers and stakeholders.

MARITIMEMARÍTIMO

Quentin Pius Caminada

PLC Marine Group
Company Profile

PLC Marine Group is a Mexican- and European-owned holding company that connects marine brands and dealers across Mexico. Its 22-person team brings international experience in technology, data-led operations, investment, large-scale project delivery and the marine industry, and runs the business from Mérida, Yucatán — chosen as its operational and logistics hub for its stability, safety and reliable business environment — to supply and support customers throughout Mexico and Latin America.

Its portfolio of 25 complementary brand lines covers marine climate systems, power and energy (lithium batteries, inverter/chargers and solar charging), coatings, antifouling and decking, pumps, wiring, hardware and marine equipment, serving leisure boating, commercial fishing, government fleets and commercial shipping.

Through PLC Marine One Hub (PMOH), its dealer platform, partners get inventory visibility, dealer pricing, product matching, warranty workflows, training, certifications and a technical library, backed from Mérida by system specification, logistics, commissioning and after-sales support.

Professional Background

At PLC Marine Group, Quentin Pius Caminada connects global marine brands with dealers and customers across Mexico, focusing on building lasting partnerships, providing practical solutions and ensuring reliable support for the recreational and commercial marine industries.

PLC Marine Group es un holding de capital mexicano y europeo que conecta marcas náuticas con distribuidores en todo México. Company Profile

Chichén Itzá International Airport is a strategic platform for air, tourism, logistics and commercial connectivity in southeast Mexico. Its location, close to one of the wonders of the world, offers opportunities in commercial and executive aviation, air cargo, aircraft maintenance and international logistics infrastructure.

With a vision of regional integration, the airport seeks to complement the main airports of the Yucatán Peninsula, attract national and international investment and open new business between Mexico, the United States, Central and South America — combining airport infrastructure, real-estate and industrial development potential and proximity to high-value tourist destinations.

A pilot by profession, Salvador Bisogno Peniche is an executive with more than 20 years of experience in aviation and international business development. Roger Góngora García

Undersecretary of Investment, Commerce and Industry
Government of the State of Yucatán · SETY
Institution Profile

The Secretariat of Economy and Labor (Secretaría de Economía y Trabajo, SETY) of the Government of the State of Yucatán organizes this Economic Mission as part of the State's International Promotion Strategy.

The strategy seeks to position Yucatán as a strategic platform for advanced manufacturing, construction and logistics integration close to the U.S. market, strengthening the integration of local companies into Bay County supply chains and leveraging direct maritime connectivity across the Gulf of Mexico.

Professional Background

Roger Góngora García holds a degree in Actuarial Science from Instituto Tecnológico Autónomo de México (ITAM) and certifications in project management and sustainable development. In the public and private sectors he has built experience in financial analysis, project management and development strategy: he served as Interim Director General of the Yucatán Development Agency (Agencia para el Desarrollo de Yucatán, ADY), as a financial analyst at Grupo BAL, and as a consultant specializing in infrastructure, energy and technology projects. He now heads SETY's Undersecretariat of Investment, Commerce and Industry.

Gobierno del Estado de Yucatán · SETY
Perfil Institucional

La Secretaría de Economía y Trabajo (SETY) del Gobierno del Estado de Yucatán organiza esta Misión Económica como parte de la Estrategia de Promoción Internacional del Estado.

La estrategia busca posicionar a Yucatán como plataforma estratégica de manufactura avanzada, construcción e integración logística cerca del mercado estadounidense, fortaleciendo la integración de las empresas locales en las cadenas de proveeduría de Bay County y aprovechando la conectividad marítima directa a través del Golfo de México.

Trayectoria Profesional

María Fernanda Pedroza Ancona es Ingeniera Industrial y de Sistemas por la Universidad Marista de Mérida. Como Directora de Promoción y Atracción de Inversiones de la SETY, contribuye a fortalecer el desarrollo económico de Yucatán mediante la promoción de oportunidades de inversión, el impulso de alianzas estratégicas y la vinculación con inversionistas nacionales e internacionales. Su experiencia profesional en gestión administrativa y financiera, planeación estratégica, logística y operaciones de cadena de suministro aporta una visión empresarial integral a su labor en el sector público.

Objetivos de la misión
  • Relaciones bilaterales
  • Buenas prácticas
  • Atracción de inversiones
  • Conexiones logísticas
Sectores estratégicos
  • Textil y confección
  • Industria automotriz y componentes aeronáuticos
  • Manufactura especializada, metalmecánica e industria eléctrica
  • Logística, transporte y servicios de carga internacional
  • Tecnología, innovación e industrias creativas
  • Materiales de construcción e infraestructura

GOVERNMENTGOBIERNO

Miguel Ángel Estrella Barbeito

Chief of Staff, Undersecretariat of Investment, Commerce and Industry
Government of the State of Yucatán · SETY
Institution Profile

The Secretariat of Economy and Labor (Secretaría de Economía y Trabajo, SETY) of the Government of the State of Yucatán organizes this Economic Mission as part of the State's International Promotion Strategy.

The strategy seeks to position Yucatán as a strategic platform for advanced manufacturing, construction and logistics integration close to the U.S. market, strengthening the integration of local companies into Bay County supply chains and leveraging direct maritime connectivity across the Gulf of Mexico.

Professional Background

Miguel Ángel Estrella Barbeito holds a degree in Economics and a Master's degree in Government and Public Policy. His professional experience focuses on public administration, political marketing, economic development and institutional coordination. As Chief of Staff of the Undersecretariat of Investment, Commerce and Industry, he coordinates strategic agendas and supports investment promotion, trade and industrial development initiatives. He also leads and coordinates international trade missions, accompanying business delegations to facilitate meetings, strengthen commercial relationships and identify business opportunities.

Mission objectives
  • Bilateral relations
  • Best practices
  • Investment attraction
  • Logistics connections
Strategic sectors
  • Textiles & apparel
  • Automotive and aerospace components
  • Specialized manufacturing, metal-mechanics and electrical industry
  • Logistics, transportation and international freight services
  • Technology, innovation and creative industries
  • Construction materials and infrastructure

Institution Profile

The Secretariat of Economy and Labor (Secretaría de Economía y Trabajo, SETY) of the Government of the State of Yucatán organizes this Economic Mission as part of the State's International Promotion Strategy.

The strategy seeks to position Yucatán as a strategic platform for advanced manufacturing, construction and logistics integration close to the U.S. market, strengthening the integration of local companies into Bay County supply chains and leveraging direct maritime connectivity across the Gulf of Mexico.

Professional Background

Alejandro Peniche Castillo heads the International Investment Department of Yucatán's Secretariat of Economy and Labor (SETY), focusing on attracting foreign direct investment, fostering international business relationships and supporting strategic investment projects in the state. He holds a degree in Business and Information Technology Engineering from Tecnológico de Monterrey and previously worked at EY as a Technology Risk Consultant. PORT AUTHORITYAUTORIDAD PORTUARIA

Elisa Gianina Capellini Álvarez

Commercial Manager
ASIPONA Progreso
Institution Profile

The Administración del Sistema Portuario Nacional Progreso (ASIPONA Progreso) is the federal government entity that manages, operates, develops and modernizes the port infrastructure of Progreso, Yucatán — a strategic logistics platform for national and international maritime trade in southeast Mexico.

Its advantages: a privileged location on the Gulf of Mexico, connected to routes serving the Caribbean, the United States and Central America; infrastructure for general cargo, bulk and cruise operations; road and rail links for distribution; and an expansion project that aims to triple operating capacity and attract investment.

Professional Background

Elisa Gianina Capellini Álvarez holds a degree in Business Administration from Universidad del Valle de México and master's degrees in Maritime and Port Law and in Public Administration. As Commercial Manager of ASIPONA Progreso she leads strategies to strengthen the port commercially, attract new lines of business, promote its competitive advantages and coordinate cruise, cargo, logistics and infrastructure promotion. She previously managed Marina Cozumel and coordinated fishing ports for ASIPONA Progreso, and is a member of WISTA México.

Elisa Gianina Capellini Álvarez

Gerente de Comercialización
ASIPONA Progreso
Perfil Institucional

La Administración del Sistema Portuario Nacional Progreso (ASIPONA Progreso) es la entidad del Gobierno Federal encargada de administrar, operar, desarrollar y modernizar la infraestructura portuaria de Progreso, Yucatán: una plataforma logística estratégica para el comercio marítimo nacional e internacional del sureste de México.

Sus ventajas: ubicación privilegiada en el Golfo de México, con conexión a rutas hacia el Caribe, Estados Unidos y Centroamérica; infraestructura para carga general, graneles y cruceros; conectividad carretera y ferroviaria para la distribución, y un proyecto de ampliación que contempla triplicar la capacidad operativa y atraer inversiones.

Trayectoria Profesional

Elisa Gianina Capellini Álvarez es licenciada en Administración de Empresas por la Universidad del Valle de México, con máster en Derecho Marítimo y Portuario y en Administración Pública. Como Gerente de Comercialización de ASIPONA Progreso coordina estrategias para fortalecer comercialmente el puerto, atraer nuevas líneas de negocio, promover sus ventajas competitivas y coordinar la promoción de cruceros, carga, proyectos logísticos e infraestructura. Antes fue Administradora de la Marina Cozumel y Coordinadora de Puertos Pesqueros de ASIPONA Progreso; es miembro de WISTA México.

Roxana Amada Cua Cuevas

Deputy Manager of Planning
ASIPONA Progreso
Institution Profile

The Administración del Sistema Portuario Nacional Progreso (ASIPONA Progreso) is the federal government entity that manages, operates, develops and modernizes the port infrastructure of Progreso, Yucatán — a strategic logistics platform for national and international maritime trade in southeast Mexico.

Its advantages: a privileged location on the Gulf of Mexico, connected to routes serving the Caribbean, the United States and Central America; infrastructure for general cargo, bulk and cruise operations; road and rail links for distribution; and an expansion project that aims to triple operating capacity and attract investment.

Professional Background

Roxana Amada Cua Cuevas is a civil engineer with a master's in engineering from Universidad Autónoma de Yucatán (UADY) and Deputy Manager of Planning at ASIPONA Progreso, part of Mexico's Navy (SEMAR). In 20 years of professional experience — 12 in the federal port administration — she has taken an active part in developing infrastructure projects for the Port of Progreso and Yucatán's fishing and tourist ports. She is part of the multidisciplinary team developing the Port of Progreso Expansion and Modernization Project, analyzing the business lines and terminals planned for its 80-hectare expansion.

TECHNOLOGYTECNOLOGÍA

Mauricio Ávila

Commercial Director
TechSBS
Company Profile

TechSBS is a Mexican intelligence, assessment, and development ecosystem that connects reliable data with strategic decisions, improvement initiatives, and sustainable results. It combines technology with specialized methodologies to assess and develop competencies, leadership, trust, culture, behaviors, and performance across individuals, teams, and organizations. Its solutions include Talent Meter, for assessing competencies and behaviors; HDC, for assessing trust; and tools for cultural and organizational intelligence. TechSBS also develops customized assessment instruments through specialized design, piloting, and methodological validation. Its ecosystem helps identify strengths and gaps, analyze trends, set development priorities, and monitor progress.

Professional Background

TechSBS is a business initiative that brings together Techmaleon’s expertise in technological innovation, digital strategy, software development, artificial intelligence, and process automation with SBS Facilitadores’ experience in strategic consulting, cultural transformation, leadership, and organizational development. This synergy combines advanced technological capabilities with more than two decades of consulting and business development experience dating back to 2003, creating digital solutions for assessment, analytics, and organizational intelligence. TechSBS leverages these strengths to offer innovative, adaptable tools across industries, helping organizations turn data into strategic decisions, develop talent, and achieve measurable, sustainable results.

Business Opportunities
  • Buyers
  • Distributors
  • Suppliers (not selected)
  • Strategic alliances
  • Export (not selected)
  • Import (not selected)
Objectives for the Mission
“TechSBS seeks to establish commercial and strategic partnerships with companies, consulting firms, and human resources specialists in Florida interested in digital solutions for assessing and developing talent, leadership, culture, and performance. Its goal is to commercialize organizational intelligence tools, develop joint projects, and establish commercial partnerships to expand its solutions in the U.S. market.”

Mauricio Ávila

Director Comercial
TechSBS
Perfil de la Empresa

TechSBS es un ecosistema mexicano de inteligencia, evaluación y desarrollo que conecta datos confiables con decisiones estratégicas, iniciativas de mejora y resultados sostenibles. Combina tecnología con metodologías especializadas para evaluar y desarrollar competencias, liderazgo, confianza, cultura, comportamientos y desempeño en personas, equipos y organizaciones. Sus soluciones incluyen Talent Meter, para evaluar competencias y comportamientos; HDC, para evaluar la confianza, y herramientas de inteligencia cultural y organizacional. TechSBS también desarrolla instrumentos de evaluación a la medida mediante diseño especializado, pilotaje y validación metodológica. Su ecosistema ayuda a identificar fortalezas y brechas, analizar tendencias, definir prioridades de desarrollo y dar seguimiento al avance.

Trayectoria Profesional

TechSBS es una iniciativa empresarial que reúne la experiencia de Techmaleon en innovación tecnológica, estrategia digital, desarrollo de software, inteligencia artificial y automatización de procesos con la experiencia de SBS Facilitadores en consultoría estratégica, transformación cultural, liderazgo y desarrollo organizacional. Esta sinergia combina capacidades tecnológicas avanzadas con más de dos décadas de experiencia en consultoría y desarrollo de negocios, desde 2003, para crear soluciones digitales de evaluación, analítica e inteligencia organizacional. TechSBS aprovecha estas fortalezas para ofrecer herramientas innovadoras y adaptables a distintas industrias, que ayudan a las organizaciones a convertir datos en decisiones estratégicas, desarrollar talento y lograr resultados medibles y sostenibles.

  • Proveedores (not selected)

Objetivos en la Misión
“TechSBS busca establecer alianzas comerciales y estratégicas con empresas, consultoras y especialistas en recursos humanos de Florida interesados en soluciones digitales para evaluar y desarrollar talento, liderazgo, cultura y desempeño. Su objetivo es comercializar herramientas de inteligencia organizacional, desarrollar proyectos conjuntos y establecer alianzas comerciales para expandir sus soluciones en el mercado estadounidense.”
